response.overview: A forbidden love story caused by family conflict. Faith and Ainnura fell in love in school and wanted to marry at a young age. However, their love was opposed by families who harbored grudges against each other due to a dispute over land ownership rights. Because their request was not approved by their families, Faith and Ainnura made the decision to marry in secret with the blessing of Tok Wan, Ainnura's grandmother. They lived happily until their secret was revealed. Both families tried to separate their children's marriage. Eventually, Faith was forced to divorce Ainnura and they went their separate ways. Several years pass, they meet again. Faith tries to win Ainnura's heart. However, Ainnura has to harden her heart because she fears the old problems will repeat. Especially since she has Fawwaz in her life. Ainnura's heart still wants Faith but Ainnura sets a condition: if they want to be together again, their families must reconcile first.
response.title: Rindu Yang Terlarang
